Pillow Room

SleepsBedsCoolingBathroom
3 people3 bedsAir conditioningShared bathroom

You would expect this bedroom to be full of pillows. But hang on! There is not even one on the bed! Or maybe if you look a bit better you could spot them. Locked in a net... Will you be smart enough to find the way to free them? This bedroom is perfect for a group of 3 people who like challenges.
